qa.question: If I play 2 or more Digimon with the [Legend-Arms] trait at the same time, do I gain 1 memory for each Digimon played with this card's inherited effect?
qa.answer: No, even if you play 2 or more Digimon with the [Legend-Arms] trait at the same time with 1 effect, you can only gain 1 memory with this card's inherited effect.

qa.question: If I have 2 Digimon with this card in their digivolution cards, and play 1 Digimon with the [Legend-Arms] trait, can I activate both inherited effects and gain 2 memory?
qa.answer: Yes, in that situation you can gain 2 memory in total.

qa.question: Can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, the effect reads "By placing this Digimon under 1 of your other Digimon [...] as its bottom digivolution card," so you may also choose to not place it as the bottom digivolution card. In such cases, it remains in the battle area as a Digimon like normal.

qa.question: When I reveal a card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect, can I choose to not play that card?
qa.answer: Yes, the effect reads "you may play it," so you may also choose to not play it. In such cases, you add it to your hand like any other card.

qa.question: I revealed a card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect] when I had a [BT9-047 Pomumon]. What happens to that card?
qa.answer: It can't be played due to [BT9-047 Pomumon]'s effect, so you add it to your hand like any other card.

qa.question: Can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, the effect reads "By placing this Digimon under 1 of your other Digimon [...] as its bottom digivolution card," so you may also choose to not place it as the bottom digivolution card. In such cases, it remains in the battle area as a Digimon like normal.

qa.question: How does this card’s inherited effect work, exactly?
qa.answer: At the end of your turn, this effect allows you to DNA digivolve the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards, along with one of your other Digimon, into a Digimon that has a DNA digivolve requirement from your hand. Note that this happens before it becomes your opponent’s turn.

qa.question: With this card's inherited effect, can I DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in my hand that doesn’t have a DNA digivolve requirement?
qa.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve into a Digimon card that doesn’t have a DNA digivolve requirement.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect allow me to DNA digivolve into a card other than the Digimon specified by [DNA Digivolution] in the hand?
qa.answer: No. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements, so you can’t DNA digivolve using Digimon that aren’t specified in [DNA Digivolution].

qa.question: If I reveal a Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less with this card's [When Attacking] effect, can I choose to not play that card?
qa.answer: Yes, "You may play" means you can choose to play it or not. If you don't play it, return it to the bottom of the deck with the rest of the cards.

qa.question: If there's a [BT9-047 Pomumon] and I reveal a Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less with this card's [When Attacking] effect, what happens to that card?
qa.answer: It can't be played due to [BT9-Pomumon]'s effect, so return it to the bottom of the deck with the rest of the cards.

qa.question: When I DNA digivolve into this card, is it possible to attack with the <Blitz> in the [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, [When Digivolving] <Blitz> can activate so long as the opponent somehow has 1 or more memory at the time.

qa.question: When I DNA digivolve into this card and it has 8 digivolution cards, do I delete 2 of my opponent's Digimon with play costs of 20 or less and trash the top 2 cards of their security stack?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: When I DNA digivolve into this card, my opponent has 1 or more memory. If there is an inherited [When Attacking] effect when I attack with the <Blitz> in the [When Digivolving] effect, do I activate the [When Attacking] effect before this card's "for every 4 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 20 or less and trash the top card of your opponent's security stack" effect?
qa.answer:
No, this card's <Blitz> and "for every 4 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 20 or less and trash the top card of your opponent's security stack" are a single effect, therefore if DNA digivolving, the latter part of the effect will continue to activate after the attack has been declared and won't be interrupted by another effect.
After the whole effect has finished activating, the [When Attacking] effect will activate.

qa.question: What does this card's "Players can't reduce play costs" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer: It negates effects that read, “reduce the play cost by X.” When you or your opponent activates an effect like that, it won't reduce the play cost that needs to be paid. The full play cost of the card needs to be paid.

qa.question: Can I omit paying the play cost by a "play this card without paying the cost" effect when I have this Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, "play this card without paying the cost" effects do not reduce the play cost, so this card does not interfere with them.

qa.question: Can the play cost of a Digimon with the [Royal Knight] trait be reduced due to the [Your Turn] effect of my opponent's [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] if this Digimon is in play?
qa.answer: No, they can't be reduced. This card's effect does not target Digimon, so even if your opponent's [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] is in the breeding area, its effect to reduce play costs can't be activated.

qa.question: When I have this Digimon, can my opponent no longer use [BT14-046 Togemon]'s [Your Turn] effect or inherited effect to reduce the play cost of green Tamer cards?
qa.answer:
That's correct. Such effects can no longer reduce play costs.
This card's effect also prevents play cost-reducing effects from activating when Tamer cards are played.

qa.question: If my Digimon is targeted by the [End of Opponent's Turn] effect of my opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] while it has this card in its digivolution cards, does this card's inherited effect prevent it from being deleted due to my opponent's effect?
qa.answer: No, this card's inherited effect has the [Opponent's Turn] timing, but the turns haven't changed at the end of your turn, so this card's inherited effect can't be activated and the effect of your opponent's [BT9-112 DeathXmon] can't be prevented.

qa.question: If there are multiple opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, can I delete them all with this card's [Main] effect?
qa.answer:
No, this card can only delete 1 Digimon.
If there are multiple opponent's Digimon with the highest DP, this card's player chooses 1 target among them to delete.

qa.question: If I don't play a Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from my hand with this card's [Main] effect, can I still activate the effect to place this card in my Battle Area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I return some of the cards revealed with this card's <Delay> effect to the top of the deck and the others to the bottom of the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. Choose whether to return all revealed cards to the top of the deck, or return all revealed cards to the bottom of the deck.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.

comprehensive-0235.title: <Delay>
comprehensive-0235.text:
16-17. <Delay>
16-17-1. <Delay> is a keyword effect. While a card with this effect is in the battle area, by trashing that card, the effect specified in <Delay> will activate.
16-17-2. The processing from <Delay> is optional. (For details, refer to 15-7 "Optional Processing Conditions")
16-17-3. <Delay> can't be activated the same turn the card with the effect is placed in the battle area.
